sub_agendas_items.title: Synthetic Fertilizer
sub_agendas_items.description:
Submitted by Councillor D. Hill:
Despite being a major global exporter of fertilizer, Canada still relies on Nitrogenous fertilizer imports to keep up with our agriculture output. Imports of this nature add additional cost to farmers with international transportation and tariffs.Converting construction waste to synthetic fertilizer is a less expensive and more environmentally friendly way to provide our agriculture community with needed resources. Ottawa is home to facilities that can convert 80% of most construction and demolition waste into recycled bio-mass fertilizer.
Increasing the viability of such facilities will also reduce the tonnage of waste being sent to the Trail West Landfill by providing more alternative streams for construction and demolition waste.
What support can the City of Ottawa provide to industry in order to reduce regulatory and legislative roadblocks to converting construction and demolition waste to synthetic fertilizers?
